title: Uruguayan Chicken Skewers with Crispy Topping
description: Savory Uruguayan-style chicken skewers topped with a crunchy and nutty topping. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan seasoning
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mix of paprika and garlic powder

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine chicken, Uruguayan seasoning, and olive oil. Toss to coat.
3. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, prepare the crispy topping by crumbling it into small pieces.
6. To assemble, brush the top of each skewer with a small amount of olive oil and sprinkle with crispy topping.
